article.title: Debian and Ubuntu APT Flaw Lets MitM Attackers Swap Verified Packages and Run Code as Root
article.summary: A flaw in APT, the package manager for Debian and Ubuntu, allows an attacker who can modify package downloads to swap a checked package for their own. The attacker's code then runs as root, according to advisories that Debian, Ubuntu, and APT's developers published on November 4. article.title: Critical Rails Flaw Lets Attackers Write Server Files via Crafted ImageMagick Uploads
article.summary: A critical flaw in Ruby on Rails could allow an unauthenticated attacker to write arbitrary files on an app's server by uploading a crafted file if the app processes uploads using ImageMagick. article.title: More Asian airlines announce data breaches after attack on Spanish IT provider Amadeus
article.summary: Japan Airlines, Cathay Pacific, Korean Air, Asiana Airlines, Singapore Airlines and Malaysia Airlines have all come forward over the last week to report data breaches traced back to Amadeus IT Group — a company that builds and maintains platforms for flight reservation, ticketing and check-in platforms.

items.relevance_reason: Nhiều hãng hàng không lớn tại châu Á xác nhận bị rò rỉ dữ liệu sau sự cố tấn công mạng nhắm vào nhà cung cấp công nghệ Amadeus.

article.title: Barracuda ESG Authentication Bypass Flaw Opens Path to Root
article.summary: An authentication bypass and a command injection flaw can be chained for root access on Barracuda’s Email Security Gateway appliances. The post Barracuda ESG Authentication Bypass Flaw Opens Path to Root appeared first on SecurityWeek .

items.relevance_reason: Lỗ hổng bỏ qua xác thực kết hợp injection trên thiết bị Barracuda ESG mở đường cho kẻ tấn công chiếm quyền root.

article.title: French bank confirms cyber heist, hackers suspected to have stolen an estimated $133 million
article.summary: Crédit Mutuel Arkéa said in a press notice that the attackers were able to make transfers using the bank’s own account after compromising an unnamed supplier.

items.relevance_reason: Ngân hàng Crédit Mutuel Arkéa của Pháp xác nhận bị trộm 133 triệu USD qua tài khoản ngân hàng sau khi nhà cung cấp bị xâm nhập.
